## Did the King Rule Alone?

The Vedic texts are among India's oldest writings. Historians read them to learn how kings governed.

**Predict:** Did a king of the Vedic period rule alone?

options.text: Yes. Whatever the king decided became the order, and he asked nobody.
No. He worked in consultation with assemblies, ministers and officers.
He answered only to priests, and assemblies played no part at all.
